verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 15 official client and server SDKs, plus over 30 SDKs in total. The quickstart directs users to integrate an SDK, and a code snippet shows the SDK API in use. A community commenter independently confirms official clients for Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python. Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference documentation in the pack, and evidence of SDK features aimed specifically at AI-native or agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
